competitors.features: Official SFBB guidelines (Cleaning, Cooking, Chilling, Cross-contamination).

competitors.weaknesses: Static non-interactive PDFs, no interactive audit drills or station-specific posters.

competitors.name: FoodDocs
competitors.features: Digital food safety software demo and static template preview.
competitors.page_structure: Product landing page with template preview.
competitors.weaknesses: Aggressive $79/mo paywall, forced account registration to download.

competitors.name: The Caterer
competitors.features: Hospitality industry advice article on commercial food prep.

competitors.weaknesses: No printable poster, no interactive tools, passive editorial text.

competitors.name: NCASS

competitors_lack: No interactive kitchen station selector (Raw Meat vs Salad vs Cookline vs Allergen Zone).
No pre-service shift readiness audit tool with instant scoring.
No jurisdiction toggle between UK General (75°C) and Scotland (82°C).
No 100% free high-contrast A4 poster generator without login or payment.
our_differentiators: Interactive station selector tailoring rules and PPE to specific culinary workstations.
8-point interactive pre-prep readiness audit drill with live EHO compliance status.
UK Standard (75°C) and Scotland (82°C) temperature standard toggle.
Printable A4 high-contrast poster with custom establishment, bench ID, and supervisor sign-off.

features_added: Multi-station rule selector (Master, Raw Meat, Veg/Salad, Cookline, Allergen-Safe)
Interactive 8-point pre-prep readiness audit drill with scoring indicator
Jurisdiction temperature toggle (75°C Eng/Wal/NI vs 82°C Scotland)
High-contrast printable A4 wall poster with supervisor sign-off block
Full FSA 4 Cs food hygiene pillar matrix

dimensions.notes: Station-specific SOP selector, interactive 8-point audit checklist, and instant A4 print vs static PDFs or paywalled software.
Detailed statutory rules covering Regulation (EC) No 852/2004, Food Safety Act 1990, BS EN 1276 chemical standards, and 48-hour sickness exclusion.
Fast, modern Next.js UI with zero ads, zero paywalls, and single-click print stylesheet.
Static SSG output, sub-second TTFB, no external third-party scripts.
Rich WebApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
Accurate UK legislation citations, clear review dates, author byline, and zero exaggerated claims.
